info.name: OkoaFloat Backend API
info.description: Import this collection, set baseUrl and credentials, then run Login followed by Verify Login OTP. Enter each OTP in the otp collection variable. Successful verification stores accessToken and refreshToken. Routes are grouped by domain (Authentication, Leave, Administration, Sales, Customer Care, Debt Collection, Organization, Reports, System). Deprecated compatibility routes are grouped under 'Compatibility (Deprecated)'.

exec: pm.test('OTP verification issues an access token', () => pm.expect(body.access_token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty);

request.description: List leads visible to the authenticated user. Optional filters: from, to, status, employee_id, include_archived.
Period analytics. Managers may also pass employee_id; dates must use YYYY-MM-DD.
Record an immutable telesales attempt. Use response=appointment with a future appointment_datetime, response=not_interested with a decline reason, or response=registered with document status details.
Escalate a lead to group_leader, department_manager, or general_manager. The reason is required.
Export call history. Use format=csv, xlsx, or pdf; date and employee filters are optional and permission-scoped.
Manager-only CSV/XLSX upload. Use form-data with a file field named file; optionally set distribute_evenly to true. Do not manually set Content-Type for multipart uploads.
Upload a CSV/XLSX portfolio in form-data using a file field named file. Do not manually set Content-Type for multipart uploads.

item.name: Compatibility (Deprecated)
item.description: Legacy compatibility routes retained for backward compatibility. Prefer the domain-specific equivalents in the categories above.
